part.text:
Cache expiration implemented in `oxidepy/cache.py:13` — `TTLCache.get_or_set`.

Expiry check at `oxidepy/cache.py:17`: `if hit is not None and (now - hit[1]) < self.ttl_seconds:` where `now = time.monotonic()` and `hit[1]` is the cached insertion timestamp. Returns cached value if within TTL, otherwise recomputes.
